officialSources.observation: Official Dharmapuri Tamil page lists Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR viewing, A-Register, patta/chitta verification, and government-poramboke lookup, and identifies the District Survey and Land Records office in the Collectorate as the local custodian.
Official English district services page lists Land Records – Patta/Chitta view.
NIC Tamil Nadu describes the Integrated Land Record service combining textual Record of Rights, FMB/maps, and Chitta, and links to Tamil Nadu e-Services and TamilNilam.
Official TNGIS application directory is a statewide GIS platform and displays Dharmapuri as a district selection, but the inspected public HTML did not expose a parcel-layer URL or schema.
